## The Dashboard Discrepancy

The 88.9% figure is **misleading**. Linux reports memory as "used" if it's allocated to anything — including the **disk cache** (Cached: 5 GB). That cache sits in RAM to speed up disk access but is **instantly thrown away** the moment an application needs it. So from Linux's perspective it's "used," but from a practical standpoint you have **6 GB available**.

The VPS is healthy, Chris. The 88.9% is a common dashboard misinterpretation of Linux memory reporting. Nothing is leaking or running away.
